fields.System.Title: FDN-505 — Block and unblock a location
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to block a location, so that damaged racking or a
contamination area stops receiving and issuing stock immediately.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an active location, when I block it, then no new putaway, allocation, or
  • replenishment targets it.
  • - Given a location with open tasks against it, when I block it, then I am warned and
  • the open tasks are listed.
  • - Given a blocked location holding stock, then the stock is still visible and still
  • countable, but not allocatable.
  • - Given a blocked location, when I unblock it, then it becomes usable again.
  • - Given either change, then an event is published and an audit row written.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata, inventory |
| Tables | location |
| Risks | Blocking under open tasks blocks operators mid-task ([doc 03 §7.7](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
